title: Setting up your station
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: A station is a chain of boxes around your radio. Each has a job and a right place.
lines.label: start with the radio

lines.caption: It starts with power. A power supply gives the radio 13.8 volts, through short, thick wires.
lines.label: power first

lines.caption: A meter that measures your signal goes in the feed line, between the radio and the antenna.
lines.label: meters in the feed line

lines.caption: On a battery, ampere-hours divided by the amperes you draw gives the hours it will last.
lines.label: battery time

lines.caption: For digital modes, add a computer. It trades audio with the radio and switches it to transmit.
lines.label: add a computer

lines.caption: Now build the station yourself, one piece at a time.
